_description: GITSEA-style stream candidate preview for the housing-004 / space_safety_assessed PR cycle. No funds move. This is a translation of contribution signals into GITSEA-readable credit hints — if the economic layer ever activates, this is the shape it would take.

stream_candidates.gitsea_note: Evidence submission alone is not sufficient for GITSEA credit — requires review + acceptance.
Review is a credit signal but requires merge + federation acknowledgment.
Merged safety review for a federation prerequisite. If GITSEA activates an economic stream for this condition, this contribution is the primary credit candidate.

_design_note: stream_candidate_preview is a read-only translation layer. It does not write to any su-table, does not create GITSEA streams, does not move funds. It answers: if GITSEA activates an economic stream for this claim/condition pair, who contributed, what did they do, and does the dignity guard pass? No more.
